summary: One client at Quote and one at Depth on the same stock: a book before the first quote, then the Depth client leaves and a quote reaches the Quote client.

notes: The web adapter's unsubscribe looks the Depth subscription up as RELIANCE_NSE_3 while subscribe stored it as RELIANCE_NSE_3_5, so the adapter keeps it; its client then drops the symbol from both streams and its merged fields, though the Quote client still holds it (samco_adapter.py subscribe/unsubscribe; samcoWebSocket.py _unsubscribe_locked).

deviations.reason: A quote2 frame (a book only) before Samco's first quote reaches the Quote client as a Quote frame with ltp 0.0 and zero OHLC, volume and OI the stream never sent; the web sends quote2 frames to Depth subscribers only.

The desktop sends Samco's web name for last_quantity (last_trade_quantity, which the web's Quote frames carry) in Depth frames too, beside last_quantity; the web's Depth frames carry last_quantity only.
deviations.ref: feed::dialect (WS-05): aliases in Quote and Depth alike

deviations.reason: The web's Samco adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Follows the web adapter in Phase B through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Samco: the number).
Before Samco's first quote frame the desktop sends oi 0, a value Samco did not send (the quote2 stream carries no OI): it must be left out with the other quote fields.
deviations.ref: streaming.rs quote_tick (int of a missing oI); feed::bridge depth_update

deviations.reason: The web's Samco adapter sends no open_interest key beside oi; the desktop sends both. Follows the web adapter in Phase B through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Samco: no open_interest).

When the Depth client leaves, the desktop keeps the quote2 stream's book totals (tbq/taq) merged and prefers them to the quote stream's fresh tBQ/tSQ, so the Quote client is shown the totals of a book it no longer streams; the web's client drops the symbol's merged fields on that unsubscribe and sends the quote's own totals.
deviations.ref: streaming.rs mode_change_frames (state kept) and first_present; samcoWebSocket.py _unsubscribe_locked
